caveats: Nothing in this issue was played or tested.

Monster Rancher 2 shrine: DuckStation is supported according to LegendCup's May 2025 capture; whether DuckStation passes the table of contents of compressed CHD images through correctly is unverified.
The Culdcept Metacritic score (78) comes from the PCSX2 wiki only; the Metacritic page returned HTTP 410.
Steambot Chronicles: the PCSX2 desktop known issues may or may not apply to Android PCSX2 forks.
New Horizons: the SNES version was not examined; article details are Genesis-specific.
